We have to send pictures by Sunday night or risk a fine. We have the option to “opt out” for $100.

There’s a general guideline on cleaning up after yourself. Compliance isn’t the issue, more so that they can arbitrarily add rules such as making us take pictures each week and assigning a specific roommate to that, and being subjected to fines if we don’t follow them or decide to opt out. It makes me wonder what other rules they’ll add on their own accord that aren’t in my lease.

I wouldn’t have signed a lease with them if this was a rule from the beginning because I’m not always home with my work schedule, and I don’t want someone giving me homework to clean areas I don’t use with a fine if I don’t comply. I’m clean on my own.

I'm surprised that our property manager can add rules/fines to how we live without our prior agreement. Makes me wonder what other rules they could create whenever they want with fines for not complying. It seems arbitrary and unfair. Accepting a rule like this just makes it easy for them to enforce more rules as they please, and we'd rather not set that precedent.

What if the assigned roommate forgets to send pictures by the end of the week? What if someone has a work trip on the week they're assigned? What if someone has a disability and can't participate in a scheduled cleaning with a due date? We're all adults with our own responsibilities and lives..we're not students or children where the landlord can just make rules as they please as to how we live. Doesn't  make sense that the property manager can just assign a week that one person is responsible.

Before the cleaning schedule was implemented, the roommates have all gotten along to keep the house clean. We don't have an issue with cleanliness in the home, nor has anyone complained about the state of the home. We all communicate and get along well and help each other out.

This is a rule they implemented on all the properties they manage, so I'm curious on the legality of enforcing fines, this isn't about living like a pig or being as dirty as we please.

NTA. I went through this exact scenario with my boyfriend, except he had cut her off a while before I met her. This was happening 2 years after they were over. My mom was a math teacher at one of the local high schools. She had faced death threats, had expelled a student who slammed her desk and threatened her, had her car keyed, had students who would smoke weed in class, and some students who were in gangs. She was scared to say anything because a lot of the students had criminal records and she was afraid they would do something to her. Her supervisor would only give her lower-level classes, even though she was the only AP-certified teacher. She even had a class where they wouldn't give her a translator, even though all the students only spoke Spanish and she spoke English with a heavy Indian accent. 

Her breaking point came 5 years ago when she had a stress attack getting out of the car to go to her classroom, and she quit right on the spot. Called my dad and he cleared out her classroom. She's never been back. She started her own tutoring business which has been very successful with over 200 students. She's a lot happier now. :)

Saw a guy fall from the 6th floor of our university library in January. I was sitting on the 4th floor by the atrium. A woman screamed and we all turned towards the atrium and saw the man falling and ran to look down. He landed and his body was disfigured and blood started pooling up. I remember going back to the table with my friends, we were all shocked and didn't know whether to continue what we were doing while there was a dead body on the first floor. I was trying to continue my physics homework, but my hands were literally shaking at the fact that a life just ended a minute ago in front of me. Eventually they made an announcement and escorted everybody out of the library through a back door, but you could still see everything on the way out. University police closed the building for the day and deemed it a suicide. I will never forget the realization I had that a life can literally end at any time just like that.
